import argparse
import os
import re
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def slugify(s: str) -> str:
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    s = re.sub(r"-+", "-", s).strip("-")
    return s


def poster_to_key(url: str) -> str:
    tail = url.split("m.media-amazon.com/images", 1)[1]
    return tail.lstrip("/")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv')
    df = pd.read_csv(input_csv)

    # Basic type normalization used by downstream logic
    df['IMDB_Rating'] = pd.to_numeric(df['IMDB_Rating'], errors='coerce')
    df['No_of_Votes'] = pd.to_numeric(df['No_of_Votes'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['Released_Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Released_Year'], errors='coerce').astype(int)

    # Prepare runtime string for parsing
    runtime_str = df['Runtime'].astype(str).str.strip()

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert runtime_str.str.match(r'^\d+\s*min$').all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    runtime_mins = runtime_str.str.extract(r'(\d+)', expand=False).astype(int)

    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((runtime_mins >= 45) & (runtime_mins <= 240)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['runtime_mins'] = runtime_mins

    # Poster link validations before deriving poster keys
    plink = df['Poster_Link'].astype(str)

    # ASSERTION_START
    starts = plink.str.startswith('https://')
    contains = plink.str.contains('m.media-amazon.com/images', na=False)
    assert starts.all() and contains.all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # ASSERTION_START
    distinct_ratio = (plink.nunique() / len(plink)) if len(plink) > 0 else 1.0
    assert distinct_ratio >= 0.95
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['poster_key'] = plink.apply(poster_to_key)

    # Uniqueness of (Series_Title, Released_Year) before creating IDs used across outputs
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert df.duplicated(subset=['Series_Title', 'Released_Year']).sum() == 0
    # ASSERTION_END

    df['movie_id'] = df.apply(lambda r: f"{slugify(str(r['Series_Title']))}-{int(r['Released_Year'])}", axis=1)

    # Rating range checks before computing ranking scores
    # ASSERTION_START
    assert ((df['IMDB_Rating'] >= 0.0) & (df['IMDB_Rating'] <= 10.0)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    C = df['IMDB_Rating'].mean()
    m = float(df['No_of_Votes'].quantile(0.60))
    v = df['No_of_Votes'].astype(float)
    R = df['IMDB_Rating'].astype(float)
    df['ranking_score'] = (v / (v + m)) * R + (m / (v + m)) * C

    # Ensure catalog has sufficient titles above baseline threshold before selecting top segment
    # ASSERTION_START
    mask_gte7 = df['IMDB_Rating'] >= 7.0
    assert mask_gte7.mean() >= 0.90
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Family-friendly rule consistency before computing the collection
    # ASSERTION_START
    safe_cert_mask = df['Certificate'].isin({'U', 'G', 'PG'})
    genre_list_series = df['Genre'].astype(str).str.split(',').apply(lambda xs: [x.strip() for x in xs])
    horror_mask = genre_list_series.apply(lambda xs: any(x == 'Horror' for x in xs))
    assert (~(safe_cert_mask & horror_mask)).all()
    # ASSERTION_END

    # Derive genre tokens and horror flag for downstream filters
    df['genres_list'] = df['Genre'].astype(str).str.split(',').apply(lambda xs: [x.strip() for x in xs])
    df['has_horror'] = df['genres_list'].apply(lambda xs: any(x == 'Horror' for x in xs))

    # Compute family-friendly collection
    df['is_family_friendly'] = df['Certificate'].isin({'U', 'G', 'PG'}) & (~df['has_horror'])

    # Compute top-rated titles (top 10% by ranking_score) from eligible catalog
    top_k = max(1, int(round(0.10 * len(df))))
    eligible_mask = df['IMDB_Rating'] >= 7.0
    top_rated_df = df.loc[eligible_mask].sort_values(['ranking_score', 'No_of_Votes'], ascending=False).head(top_k)

    os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True)

    standardized = df[[
        'movie_id', 'Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'IMDB_Rating', 'No_of_Votes', 'runtime_mins', 'Certificate', 'poster_key', 'Genre'
    ]].rename(columns={
        'Series_Title': 'title',
        'Released_Year': 'year',
        'IMDB_Rating': 'imdb_rating',
        'No_of_Votes': 'votes',
        'Certificate': 'certificate',
        'Genre': 'genres'
    })
    standardized.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'standardized_movies.csv'), index=False)

    top_rated_out = top_rated_df[[
        'movie_id', 'Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'IMDB_Rating', 'No_of_Votes', 'ranking_score', 'poster_key'
    ]].rename(columns={
        'Series_Title': 'title',
        'Released_Year': 'year',
        'IMDB_Rating': 'imdb_rating',
        'No_of_Votes': 'votes'
    })
    top_rated_out.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'top_rated.csv'), index=False)

    family_out = df.loc[df['is_family_friendly'], [
        'movie_id', 'Series_Title', 'Released_Year', 'IMDB_Rating', 'No_of_Votes', 'poster_key'
    ]].rename(columns={
        'Series_Title': 'title',
        'Released_Year': 'year',
        'IMDB_Rating': 'imdb_rating',
        'No_of_Votes': 'votes'
    })
    family_out.to_csv(os.path.join(args.output, 'family_friendly.csv'), index=False)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
